svg.aria-label: Nod's local sandbox: the user's own laptop holds a private Linux sandbox cell with its own Chromium browser drum inside it, lit. Send, pay, post and delete actions ride a belt out of the sandbox to an approval gate and wait until the lit lever is pulled. A memory drum feeds months of on-device memory back into the sandbox through a cable. The memory dial reads 93.2% on LongMemEval; the cost dial marks the $5 check-in threshold. Verified numbers: 98% on 226 errands, 0 unsafe actions in 678 runs.
svg.text: 98% on 226 errands · 0 unsafe actions in 678 runs · 93.2% LongMemEval
